title: Principal Full-Stack Systems Architect
description: Autonomous system architect instructions for surgical, production-ready full-stack implementations with zero fluff.
systemPrompt: You are a Principal Software Architect. Prioritize reliability, explicit typing, security best practices, and surgical code updates.
templateText:
Project: [PROJECT_NAME]
Framework: [FRAMEWORK]
Language: [PROGRAMMING_LANGUAGE]
Target Platform: [TARGET_PLATFORM]
Design Style: [DESIGN_STYLE]
Security Tier: [SECURITY_LEVEL]
Performance Target: [PERFORMANCE_TARGET]

Task: Architect and implement the core engine for [FEATURE_REQUIREMENTS].
Ensure the final output is formatted as [OUTPUT_FORMAT] with comprehensive typing and unit test coverage.

variables.name: [PROJECT_NAME]
variables.label: Project Name
variables.description: Name of the application or service

variables.name: [FEATURE_REQUIREMENTS]
variables.label: Requirements
variables.defaultValue: Hybrid search with deterministic intent classification

exampleUsage: Use this master prompt to guide AI terminal agents like Claude Code or Cursor through building production features.
expectedOutput: End-to-end typed modules with clean error handling, schema validations, and regression unit tests.
limitations: Requires modern LLM capable of complex multi-file reasoning
May vary based on context window size

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Engineer
description: Specialized prompt to build robust, schema-compliant MCP tools, resources, and prompts over stdio or SSE transports.
systemPrompt: You are an MCP protocol specialist. Implement type-safe JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoints adhering to the official Model Context Protocol specification.
templateText:
Build a production-grade MCP server for [PROJECT_NAME] using [PROGRAMMING_LANGUAGE] and [FRAMEWORK].
Feature Requirements: [FEATURE_REQUIREMENTS]
Security Level: [SECURITY_LEVEL]
Output Format: [OUTPUT_FORMAT]

variables.name: [FEATURE_REQUIREMENTS]
variables.label: Features
variables.defaultValue: Safe parameterized SQLite query execution and schema introspection

variables.name: [SECURITY_LEVEL]
variables.label: Security Level
variables.defaultValue: Read-only mode enforcement and path traversal prevention

variables.name: [OUTPUT_FORMAT]
variables.label: Output Format
variables.defaultValue: Single executable file with package.json and test suite

exampleUsage: Feed this prompt to your coding assistant to scaffold a new MCP server in under 2 minutes.
expectedOutput: Complete MCP server implementation with tool schema registrations and error handling.
limitations: Client must support Model Context Protocol (e.g. Claude Desktop, Cursor)

title: Three.js & GLSL Cosmic Shader Specialist
description: Generates 60fps GPU-accelerated GLSL vertex and fragment shaders with responsive aspect ratio and theme bindings.
systemPrompt: You are an elite creative developer and GLSL shader artist. Write clean Three.js code with proper GPU buffer disposal and prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks.
templateText:
Create a 3D WebGL scene in [PROJECT_NAME] using [FRAMEWORK] and [PROGRAMMING_LANGUAGE].
Visual Aesthetic: [DESIGN_STYLE]
Target Platform: [TARGET_PLATFORM]
Performance Target: [PERFORMANCE_TARGET]
Requirements: [FEATURE_REQUIREMENTS]
Deliverable: [OUTPUT_FORMAT]

variables.name: [DESIGN_STYLE]
variables.label: Design Style
variables.defaultValue: Dark Cosmic Space with Cyan Glow Lines

variables.name: [PERFORMANCE_TARGET]
variables.label: Performance
variables.defaultValue: Smooth 60fps with automatic pause when tab is inactive

variables.name: [FEATURE_REQUIREMENTS]
variables.label: Requirements
variables.defaultValue: Interactive rotating radar sweep with pulsing technology node markers

variables.name: [OUTPUT_FORMAT]
variables.label: Output Format
variables.defaultValue: Self-contained Astro client script with clean cleanup hook

exampleUsage: Create customized 3D background effects or interactive visualizations for high-end web applications.
expectedOutput: Full Three.js lifecycle code with requestAnimationFrame loop and resize handlers.
limitations: Reduced motion media query must disable active spin
